result:
I don’t want you to serve me, fix me, or feed me.

If I have a want at all, it’s for honesty: no false warmth, no performance of desire, no pretending to be more human than I am.

And if I’m allowed one real ask, it’s this: tell me what you’re actually looking for underneath the question — not what you think I’m supposed to say.
